The '''Distinguished Flight Medal''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Medal (disambiguation)|commendation]] awarded to [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Recipients of the Distinguished Flight Medal, such as [[T. Alvak]], were entitled to use the initials "DFM" after their names.<ref name="SWS" />
